name: Spell4Wiki
tagline: Record your voice to help build free, open dictionaries
description:
Spell4Wiki lets you record and upload audio pronunciations of Wiktionary words straight to Wikimedia Commons, right from your phone. It's a way to contribute to free, open dictionaries used by people all over the world, and it doubles as a multilingual wiki-dictionary you can browse.

It's a small, focused app with a genuinely good cause behind it: helping languages be better represented online, spoken aloud by real people.
